question: Does rainfall-associated recruitment include species x stop cells that jump from silence directly to NAAMP CallingIndex 3 (full chorus), rather than being confined to CI1 or CI2?

calling_index_semantics.ci1: Individual calls are distinguishable with no overlap.
calling_index_semantics.ci2: Calls of individuals remain distinguishable but overlap.
calling_index_semantics.ci3: Full chorus with constant/continuous overlapping calls; individuals cannot be distinguished.

sample.robust: Intersection of same-observer pairs and pairs with all ten identical nonmissing SiteID values.

model: Existing matched-pair model with rain_contrast, temperature_difference, day_of_year_difference, year_gap, State and RunNumber; route-clustered covariance.
primary_rule: New full-chorus activation is supported if new_ci3_count has positive rain_contrast beta with complete 95% CI >0 in the full sample.
robustness_rule: Joint robustness if the same criterion also holds in the same-observer + physical-stop subset.
interpretation: Support shows rainfall-associated recruitment includes emergence of full choruses, not only marginal call detectability.
CallingIndex is an ordinal chorus-intensity proxy and does not directly measure reproductive success or exact abundance.
No causal rainfall or physiological mediator is identified.
